paragraphs: A fashion store with a customer storefront, an admin panel, online payments, and AI shopping helpers. The frontend is Next.js and the backend is an Express + MongoDB REST API.
The backend runs on Render's free tier, so the first request after a while can take 30–60 seconds while the server wakes up.
features: Shopping: product listing with filters and sorting, product detail page, search, compare, wishlist, cart, and "save for later"
Checkout: address validation, coupons, and three payment methods: Cash on Delivery (charge depends on the delivery zone), Card (Stripe), and bKash
Account: login/signup with email, Google Sign-In, or email OTP, plus optional 2FA. Includes profile, addresses, orders, and notifications
Orders: order tracking, email updates on each status change, "Pay now" for unpaid online orders, and cancellation
Returns & refunds: request a return or refund on a delivered order within 7 days (RETURNWINDOWDAYS) and follow it on a return → approval → refund timeline

whatItDoes.text: A fashion store with a customer storefront, an admin panel, online payments, and AI shopping helpers. The frontend is Next.js and the backend is an Express + MongoDB REST API.

requirements.text: Payments, images, emails, and Google login go to external services.
Login uses a short-lived JWT access token plus a refresh token in an HttpOnly cookie. lib/apiClient.ts refreshes the token automatically.
